sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Keep attachment-local constraints on nltl:frameAttachment as previously required, but split the current TRF049FrameAttachmentEvidenceShape: it is incorrectly invoked for every frame attachment in the ice-area branch and consequently makes nltl:hasConnectionBracket mandatory for all attachments, including non-longitudinal frames and transverse frames not terminating at a deck/stringer. Use an attachment-local effective-attachment shape requiring nltl:effectiveAttachmentConfirmed true without requiring a bracket, and retain the bounded shared-attachment identity query so each declared supporting structure has a shared effective attachment.
